AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I am a Backend Software Engineer based in Noida, currently at Paytm, with experience across fintech and insurance. I design REST APIs, asynchronous workers, and event-driven flows where correctness, idempotency, and observability matter.

My work spans zero-downtime infrastructure migrations, credit-card lifecycle processing, premium/quote engines, and payroll platforms—always with an emphasis on measurable throughput and latency improvements.
Technologies I have used professionally (from my resume):
AboutMe.Skills: Go, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, SQL, C++
Microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, async workers
Apache Kafka, consumer groups, event-driven architecture
MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, query optimization
Kubernetes, Docker, AWS EC2, ArgoCD, CI/CD, HPA
Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, retries, idempotency, audit logging

Experience.Title: Professional experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Engineer — Backend
Description: Owned end-to-end EC2 → Kubernetes migration for Lending infrastructure (Resolver, Catalogue, Prefill, Credit Card Integration) with zero downtime—pod sizing, replica planning, HPA, and rollback strategies.
Executed parallel database and Kafka consumer migrations with zero message loss; handled consumer re-partitioning, integrity checkpoints, and validation runbooks.
Engineered Go and Node.js microservices for a credit-card platform processing 100K+ applications/month; REST APIs and Kafka workers cut end-to-end processing time by 30%.
Designed Kafka-based lifecycle processing for 50K+ events/day at 99.9% uptime; optimized MySQL and Redis to reduce p99 latency by 40%.
Led HDFC, SBI, Axis, AU Small Finance Bank, and RBL integrations—consent, OTP, KYC/Perfios, Account Aggregator, status sync, retries, and compliance workflows.
Architected Axis Bank background workers (KYC polling, status sync, scheduled retries, compliance purge) supporting 500+ parallel jobs/batch with configurable concurrency.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Development Engineer I
Description: Integrated ICICI Elevate and Care Ultimate insurance plans end-to-end, reducing time-to-market by 35%.

Built premium-calculation and eligibility modules with 20+ add-ons using Node.js and MongoDB; optimized quote rendering for 50K+ daily quotes (20% lower latency via caching, lazy loading, compression).
Achieved 85%+ test coverage on critical quote/proposal flows with Jest and standardized APIs using Swagger.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Junior Software Developer
Description: Built employee lifecycle and exit-management modules for TankhaPay—onboarding, offboarding, final settlement, clearance, and statutory deductions.
Automated payroll disbursement, bank validation, and reconciliation; reduced payroll errors by 30% and cycle time by 25%.
Introduced Redis caching on high-frequency employee and payroll endpoints, cutting API response time by 40% under concurrent load.

Blue/green style traffic shift with rollback checkpoints
Parallel validation of health, Kafka lag, and DB connectivity

CaseStudies.Items.title: Kafka credit-card lifecycle pipeline

Lag, error-rate, and p99 dashboards for on-call
